title: Will vs going to
examples: I am going to book the tickets tonight.
Don't worry — I will help you.
pattern: going to = planned intention  |  will = offer / spontaneous decision / prediction
explanation: Use going to for plans you already have. Use will for offers, promises, and decisions made at the moment of speaking.
explanationIt: Usa going to per piani già decisi. Usa will per offerte, promesse e decisioni prese al momento.
realUse: I am going to arrange a meeting on Friday.
I will help with the booking.
Looking at my schedule, Friday works for me.

exercises.prompt: Choose the best sentence for a decided plan.
options: I am going to book the tickets tonight.
I will going to book the tickets tonight.
I going book the tickets tonight.
I am will book the tickets tonight.
exercises.answer: I am going to book the tickets tonight.
exercises.explanation: Going to shows a prior intention.

exercises.prompt: Fix: I will going to call him later.
options: I am going to call him later.
I will going call him later.
I going to call him later.
I will to call him later.
exercises.answer: I am going to call him later.
